description: A public trader's book by handle: open holdings and perps with value and PnL, closed positions, cash, realized PnL and the balance curve. Dust is hidden unless include_dust is true.

include.description:
Comma-separated sections (`holdings`, `closed`, `activity`,
`realized_history`, `balance_history`, `perps`, `cash_rows`).
Omitted returns every section. An unknown name is a 400.

limit.description:
Caps holdings and closed positions each, 1-200 (default 50); above
200 is read as 200.

sort.description: Order of holdings and closed positions (default newest).

name: get_trader_portfolio
title: Get trader portfolio
